Package logic

Class GuideDetail

java.lang.Object
logic.GuideDetail
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GuideDetail extends Object implements Serializable
read-only projection of a row in the guides table. transferred between server and client for the Manage Guides panel and the guide-registration confirmation.

  • Constructor Details

    • GuideDetail

      public GuideDetail(String idNumber, String firstName, String lastName, String email, String phone, int isApproved)
      Parameters:
      idNumber - the guide's government-issued ID number
      firstName - the guide's first name
      lastName - the guide's last name
      email - the guide's contact email, or null (stored as empty)
      phone - the guide's contact phone, or null (stored as empty)
      isApproved - 1 if the department manager has approved the guide, 0 while the guide is still pending approval

    • capitalize

      private static String capitalize(String s)
      Capitalizes the first letter of each word; handles null, empty, and mixed-case input. Self-contained here (no dependency on the client-only UserSession) so this DTO can live in the shared module and be bundled into both the client and server jars.
